dex.entry: Vulpyre's kindled middle form — a lean adolescent ember-fox caught between kit and crown. Its mane has lifted into a running crest of small steady flames and its paws leave brief warm prints that fade like blown-out matches. Quick-tempered but loyal, it circles its trainer at dusk like a lantern doi

art.silhouette: Lean adolescent fox, deep ember-red coat with cream underbelly and chest blaze; mane risen into a low crest of orange flame tongues tipped white; longer legs and brush tail with a glowing ember core; alert amber eyes. Clearly between Vulpyre's round kit and Blazethorn's spike-crowned regal fox at 64px.
